datapad_eng_vasquez.title: Primary Bus Harmonic Induction Notes
datapad_eng_vasquez.author: Chief Engineer Elena Vasquez
datapad_eng_vasquez.location_hint: Engineering Bay — Workbench near Recharge Cradle
datapad_eng_vasquez.summary: Details abnormal 47.3 Hz harmonic induction on the primary electrical bus after the mutant specimen attacked power conduits.
datapad_eng_vasquez.content:
PERSONAL BENCH SLATE // CHIEF ENGINEER VASQUEZ

This isn't a simple turbine bearing fault. Ever since the mutant specimen broke out of Dr. Thorne's secret breeding chamber, it has been deliberately targeting our electrical infrastructure. I isolated Generator 2 from the excitation coils, yet the primary bus is still ringing at a locked 47.3 Hz harmonic.

The creature is drawn to the electromagnetic field, chewing through high-voltage conduits. If I leave the main breaker closed while the core is uncalibrated, the power surge will destroy our containment shields. I'm pulling the main breaker and heading down to the subdeck to secure the auxiliary poisonous gas reserves.

datapad_subdeck_throttle.title: Subdeck Deuterium Valve Override Log
datapad_subdeck_throttle.author: Chief Engineer Elena Vasquez
datapad_subdeck_throttle.location_hint: Reactor Subdeck — Auxiliary Fuel Flow Valve Manifold
datapad_subdeck_throttle.summary: Reveals Vasquez throttled fuel injection and verified poisonous gas decontamination lines to prepare a trap for the creature.
datapad_subdeck_throttle.content:
MAINTENANCE OVERRIDE SLATE // REACTOR SUBDECK VAULT

I've mechanically throttled the auxiliary deuterium-helium3 injection valve by 18% to prevent core resonance, and inspected the high-pressure poisonous gas line connecting to the decontamination chamber. The creature is stalking the upper levels, and its thick hide deflects our pulse rifles.

Thorne confirmed the beast's synthetic respiratory system cannot survive neuro-toxic decontamination gas. If we lure the alien into the sealed chamber, we can flood it by opening the manual emergency valve. Once you correlate this phase offset with the Avionics telemetry, the reactor will engage harmonic damping—providing +10 kW auxiliary headroom to power the decontamination pumps.

datapad_avionics_telemetry.title: Kharon-4 Magnetosphere Carrier Telemetry
datapad_avionics_telemetry.author: Nav Officer Marcus Lin
datapad_avionics_telemetry.location_hint: Server Core & Avionics Bay — Optical Relay Racks
datapad_avionics_telemetry.summary: Corrupted flight telemetry shard confirming the mutant alien broadcasts a bio-electric carrier wave in resonance with Kharon-4.
datapad_avionics_telemetry.content:
DECRYPTED FLIGHT TELEMETRY SHARD // AVIONICS SERVER CORE

[CARRIER WAVE RECONSTRUCTION COMPLETE — PARITY VERIFIED]

Spectral analysis of the 1.42 GHz microwave bursts confirms non-natural bio-frequency emissions. The alien predator engineered in secret Chamber 4 has bonded with the local magnetosphere, radiating electromagnetic pulses that blinded our automated security cameras.

This explains how the creature ambushed the research team without triggering hallway motion sensors. Filtering out the 47.3 Hz bio-carrier harmonic stabilizes the reactor grid and allows tracking the creature's biometric signatures across the observatory chambers.

datapad_ls_contamination.title: Bio-Filter Particulate & Amine Saturation Log
datapad_ls_contamination.author: Environmental Specialist Jian Chen
datapad_ls_contamination.location_hint: Life Support Module — Scrubber Service Column
datapad_ls_contamination.summary: Documents carbon-scrubber saturation and toxic alien bio-spores in the ventilation loop, leaving the air unbreathable.
datapad_ls_contamination.content:
ATMOSPHERIC LAB SLATE // SPECIALIST CHEN

I pulled the primary amine filter bed from Scrubber Column A after the entire research team began suffocating. The lithium-hydroxide canisters are saturated not just with carbon crusting, but with thick aerosolized bio-venom secreted by the escaped mutant beast.

The creature severed the coolant lines to intentionally foul our life support loop, making it impossible to breathe in the chambers without an EVA suit. I've programmed an emergency electrostatic purge sequence into the scrubber controller, but we need Dr. Thorne's medical triage clearance to neutralize the venom.

datapad_crew_quarantine.title: Habitation Bunk Personal Diary Slate
datapad_crew_quarantine.author: Specialist Jian Chen
datapad_crew_quarantine.summary: Recounts mysterious angry animal growls, bulkhead scratching in the vents, and the slaughter of the science team.
datapad_crew_quarantine.content:
PERSONAL LOG // CREW QUARTERS BUNK 04

Nobody has slept in three cycles. If you press your ear against the habitation vent grille, you can hear guttural, terrifying animal growls and heavy claws raking against the titanium plates—the beast is hunting us.

Reyes tried to barricade the corridor, but the creature ripped the steel doors off their hinges. It attacked with ferocious anger, killing Dr. Thorne and our zoology specialists before retreating into the dark ceilings. Commander Hayes sealed the crawlway, but we know it's only a matter of time before it finds our hiding spot.

datapad_medbay_autopsy.title: Protocol Zero-Nine Clinical Triage Record
datapad_medbay_autopsy.author: Dr. Aris Thorne, Chief Medical Officer
datapad_medbay_autopsy.summary: Encrypted clinical triage record revealing the secret alien experiment, the mistake that birthed the predator, and its vulnerability to poisonous gas.
datapad_medbay_autopsy.content:
DECRYPTED MEDICAL DOSSIER // DR. ARIS THORNE [CLEARANCE: OMEGA]

CONFESSION OF DR. THORNE // PROTOCOL ZERO-NINE

I created the monster. In our secret observatory chamber, I attempted to engineer a new animal species by combining apex alien genetics with synthetic embryonic cells. Due to a critical transcription error in codon-7, the embryo mutated uncontrollably into an unstoppable predator that broke containment and slaughtered my colleagues.

Conventional weapons cannot pierce its chitinous shell. However, my physiological necropsy reveals its respiratory tract is hyper-vulnerable to concentrated neuro-toxic decontamination gas. To our returning Lead Scientist: lure the beast into the sealed chamber, lock the pressure doors, and open the poisonous gas valve. Uploading bio-filter purge calibrations now—boosting scrubber efficiency by 20%.

datapad_cargo_manifest.title: Classified Deep-Core Sample Jettison Manifest
datapad_cargo_manifest.author: Quartermaster David Reyes
datapad_cargo_manifest.location_hint: Cargo Hold & Machine Staging — Near Sealed Salvage Crate
datapad_cargo_manifest.summary: Reveals the secret specimen breeding chamber and the frantic attempt to jettison the bio-hazard before the beast attacked.
datapad_cargo_manifest.content:
SEALED CARGO MANIFEST // QUARTERMASTER REYES

ITEM: Specimen Incubation Chamber K4-OMEGA
STATUS: CONTAINMENT BREACH — MUTANT ALIEN ESCAPED

That creature was bred right here in the classified staging bay. When it hatched, it shattered the reinforced plexiglass with a single blow and tore through the hydraulic cargo hoist. Lin and I tried to push the containment cradle toward the airlock, but the creature ambushed us from the overhead scaffolding.

In our struggle, the pneumatic ejection bolts fired erratically, cracking a titanium weld seam in the Maintenance Crawlway. The creature retreated into the ceiling conduits, waiting in the dark to hunt the Lead Scientist upon docking.

datapad_crawlway_blackbox.title: Damaged EVA Hull-Weld Flight Recorder
datapad_crawlway_blackbox.author: Nav Officer Marcus Lin
datapad_crawlway_blackbox.location_hint: Breached Maintenance Crawlway — Near Hull Fracture
datapad_crawlway_blackbox.summary: Records Specialist Lin being stalked by the mutant alien into the crawlway before sealing the bypass hatch.
datapad_crawlway_blackbox.content:
EVA SUIT BLACKBOX TRANSCRIPT // OFFICER MARCUS LIN

[PRESSURE ALARM: 98.5 kPa AND FALLING — CRAWLWAY SECTOR 4]

'Vasquez, the beast followed me down into the lower crawlway! It's right above the plating—I can hear its claws scraping against the conduit channels! The recoil from the cargo hoist sheared a micro-fracture along the port rib and I'm losing pressure fast.'

'I patched the hull seam with polymer resin and dogged the bypass hatch behind me. I left cutting fuel and battery cells in the cargo crate. Lead Scientist, when you dock: weld this breach shut, arm your Multitool, and prepare the chamber trap!'

datapad_airlock_jettison.title: Starboard Airlock Unpowered Ejection Log
datapad_airlock_jettison.author: Quartermaster David Reyes
datapad_airlock_jettison.location_hint: Airlock & EVA Staging — Near Pressure Cycle Controller
datapad_airlock_jettison.summary: Logs rigging the starboard decontamination chamber as a tactical trap with the emergency poisonous gas line.
datapad_airlock_jettison.content:
AIRLOCK MECHANICAL LOG // STARBOARD DECONTAMINATION CHAMBER

03:48 — Inner bulkhead door rigged with manual interlock override. Poisonous gas supply line primed.
03:51 — High-pressure toxic decontamination valves connected directly to the chamber manifold.

NOTE FROM REYES: The trap is set. The airlock chamber can be sealed hermetically from the outside. If the beast enters this room, lock the bulkhead door and turn the poisonous gas valve. The lethal neuro-gas will flood the enclosure in four seconds, killing the alien and cleansing Astraea Station.

datapad_bridge_directive.title: Commander Hayes's Project ORBITAL Keycard
datapad_bridge_directive.author: Commander Evelyn Hayes
datapad_bridge_directive.summary: Encrypted command keycard containing the final station directive and override code 7394-OMEGA to depart after killing the beast.
datapad_bridge_directive.content:
DECRYPTED COMMAND KEYCARD // COMMANDER EVELYN HAYES

DIRECTIVE: BIOLOGICAL RESEARCH OBSERVATORY — FINAL CONTINGENCY
OVERRIDE CLEARANCE CODE: 7394-OMEGA

To our returning Lead Scientist: The research team is gone. Dr. Thorne's secret experiment produced an apex alien monster that decimated our station. Before we fell, I locked the automated departure thrusters behind emergency clearance [7394-OMEGA] so the beast could not escape into orbital shipping lanes.

You must finish what we started: restore the generators, seal the breached chambers, trap the alien in the decontamination chamber, and exterminate it with the poisonous gas valve. Once the creature is dead, enter my override code [7394-OMEGA] to purge the quarantine lockout, reduce ion engine power draw by 20%, and return to Earth.

revelation_anomaly.title: Revelation I: The Harmonic Anomaly
revelation_anomaly.summary: The mutant alien organism engineered in the secret chamber broadcasts a 47.3 Hz bio-frequency that caused electrical surging across the primary bus. Chief Engineer Vasquez tripped the reactor breaker and throttled the subdeck fuel lines to isolate the power grid from creature interference.
revelation_anomaly.gameplay_consequence: Unlocks Reactor Harmonic Damping Optimization in ShipState: reduces reactor thermal accumulation rate by 15% and grants +10 kW auxiliary power headroom.
revelation_anomaly.bonus_summary: Reactor Thermal Rate -15% | +10 kW Auxiliary Power Headroom

revelation_quarantine.title: Revelation II: Protocol Zero-Nine & The Evacuation
revelation_quarantine.summary: Toxic bio-venom from the mutant alien fouled the ventilation loop, suffocating the research team. Dr. Thorne's final clinical triage reveals the alien's respiratory vulnerability to poisonous decontamination gas, providing the tactical plan to trap and destroy it.
revelation_quarantine.gameplay_consequence: Unlocks Atmospheric Scrubber Purge Optimization in EnvironmentalManager & ShipState: improves O2 generation and CO2 scrubbing efficiency by 20%.

revelation_directive.title: Revelation III: The Last Engineer's Directive
revelation_directive.summary: Quartermaster Reyes and Officer Lin rigged the starboard airlock chamber with poisonous gas lines to trap the beast. Commander Hayes encoded Emergency Override Code 7394-OMEGA to clear the station quarantine lockout for the Lead Scientist once the alien is exterminated.
revelation_directive.gameplay_consequence: Unlocks Commander's Emergency Override Code (7394-OMEGA) in ShipState & MissionManager: clears navigation/comms quarantine lockout and boosts ion thruster efficiency (-20% propulsion power draw).
revelation_directive.bonus_summary: Override 7394-OMEGA Active | Ion Thruster Efficiency +25% (-20% Power Draw)
